source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Nightcrawler (archived 29 June 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Born a mutant with blue fur, a prehensile tail and the power to teleport by passing through the Brimstone Dimension.

abilities.name: Teleportation
abilities.detail: Jumps through the Brimstone Dimension and back in an instant, leaving smoke and a bamf sound; about two to three miles under normal conditions.

abilities.name: Multiple ports
abilities.detail: Grabs a foe and teleports in rapid repeated jumps, draining anyone without superhuman stamina while he keeps fighting.

abilities.name: Spatial awareness
abilities.detail: A limited subconscious sense stops him arriving inside the ground, though he still avoids teleporting into places he cannot see or has not seen.

abilities.name: Shadow camouflage
abilities.detail: His indigo fur and link to the dimension he crosses let him fade into shadows, at first close to outright invisibility.

abilities.name: Wall-crawling and prehensile tail
abilities.detail: Clings to surfaces with hands and feet, and his tail can hold his weight, lift a grown man or swing a blade.

abilities.name: Superhuman agility and reflexes
abilities.detail: Agility, balance, coordination and reaction time beyond human limits, built on an unusually flexible spine.

abilities.name: Acrobat and swordsman
abilities.detail: An Olympic-class acrobat from his circus years and a master fencer, able to fight with a sword held in his tail.

feats.text: Pushed himself to his physical limit to make a vertical teleport of about one mile, against both gravity and the magnetic field.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Uncanny X-Men Vol 1 147

feats.text: While weakened and close to death, teleported himself and Hope Summers roughly 585 miles from Las Vegas to San Francisco.
After his return from death, made a single jump of about 7,853 miles from Dubai to the Savage Land.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Civil War II: X-Men Vol 1 1

feats.text: Teleported through the White House, beating a corridor of Secret Service agents and reaching the President before a gunshot wound broke his trance.
When a missile ruptured the X-Jet and Rogue was pulled out, he teleported outside in mid-air, caught her and brought her back aboard.
Teleported himself and Storm into the Cerebro chamber at Alkali Lake, where she froze Jason Stryker and broke his hold on Xavier.
